web_search.title: Web search
web_search.description: Web search. Search the web from a large independent index of web pages.

q.description: The user's search query term. Query can not be empty. Maximum of 600 characters and 75 words in the query.

country.description: The 2 character country code where the search results come from. One of: AR, AU, AT, BE, BR, CA, CL, DK, FI, FR, DE, GR, HK, IN, ID, IT, JP, KR, MY, MX, NL, NZ, NO, CN, PL, PT, PH, RU, SA, ZA, ES, SE, CH, TW, TR, GB, US, ALL. Default: US.

search_lang.description: The 2 or more character language code for which the search results are provided. One of: ar, eu, bn, bg, ca, zh-hans, zh-hant, hr, cs, da, nl, en, en-gb, et, fi, fr, gl, de, el, gu, he, hi, hu, is, it, ja, jp, kn, ko, lv, lt, ms, ml, mr, nb, pl, pt-br, pt-pt, pa, ro, ru, sr, sk, sl, es, sv, ta, te, th, tr, uk, vi. Default: en.

ui_lang.description: User interface language preferred in response. Usually of the format - . For more, see RFC 9110. One of: es-AR, en-AU, de-AT, nl-BE, fr-BE, pt-BR, en-CA, fr-CA, es-CL, da-DK, fi-FI, fr-FR, de-DE, el-GR, zh-HK, en-IN, en-ID, it-IT, ja-JP, ko-KR, en-MY, es-MX, nl-NL, en-NZ, no-NO, zh-CN, pl-PL, en-PH, ru-RU, en-ZA, es-ES, sv-SE, fr-CH, de-CH, zh-TW, tr-TR, en-GB, en-US, es-US. Default: en-US.

count.description: The number of search results returned in response. The maximum is 20. The actual number delivered may be less than requested. Combine this parameter with offset to paginate search results. NOTE: Count only applies to web results. Default: 20.

offset.description: The zero based offset that indicates number of search result pages (count) to skip before returning the result. The default is 0 and the maximum is 9. The actual number delivered may be less than requested. Use this parameter along with the count parameter to page results. For example, if your user interface displays 10 search results per page, set count to 10 and offset to 0 to get the first page of results.

safesearch.description: Filters search results for adult content. The following values are supported: - off - No filtering is done. - moderate - Filters explicit content, like images and videos, but allows adult domains in the search results. - strict - Drops all adult content from search results. Default: moderate.

spellcheck.description: Whether to spell check provided query. If the spell checker is enabled, the modified query is always used for search. The modified query can be found in altered key from the query response model. Default: true.

freshness.description: Filters search results by page age. The age of a page is determined by the most relevant date reported by the content, such as its published or last modified date. The following values are supported: - pd - Pages aged 24 hours or less. - pw - Pages aged 7 days or less. - pm - Pages aged 31 days or less. - py - Pages aged 365 days or less.

text_decorations.description: Whether display strings (e.g. result snippets) should include decoration markers (e.g. highlighting characters). Default: true.

result_filter.description: A comma delimited string of result types to include in the search response. Not specifying this parameter will return back all result types in search response where data is available and the plan has the corresponding option activated. The response always includes query and type to identify any query modifications and response type respectively.

units.description: The measurement units. The following values are supported: - metric - The standardized measurement system (km, celcius..) - imperial - The British Imperial system of units (mile, fahrenheit..)

goggles_id.description: Goggles act as a custom re-ranking on top of Brave's search index. For more details, refer to the Goggles repository. This parameter is deprecated. Please use the goggles parameter.

goggles.description: Goggles act as a custom re-ranking on top of Brave's search index. The parameter supports both a url where the Goggle is hosted or the definition of the Goggle. For more details, see the Goggles documentation. The parameter can be a single Goggle or a list of up to 3 Goggles.

extra_snippets.description: A snippet is an excerpt from a page you get as a result of the query, and extra_snippets allow you to get up to 5 additional, alternative excerpts.

summary.description: This parameter enables summary key generation in web search results. This is required for summarizer to be enabled.

enable_rich_callback.description: Enable rich callback. Allows you to get real time rich results via a callback URL when they are relevant to your query. NOTE : Requires `Search` plan. Default: false.

operators.description: Whether to apply search operators Default: true.

x_loc_lat.description: The latitude of the client's geographical location in degrees, to provide relevant local results. The latitude must be greater than or equal to -90.0 degrees and less than or equal to +90.0 degrees. Range -90 to 90.

x_loc_long.description: The longitude of the client's geographical location in degrees, to provide relevant local results. The longitude must be greater than or equal to -180.0 and less than or equal to +180.0 degrees. Range -180 to 180.

x_loc_timezone.description: The IANA timezone for the client's device. For complete list of IANA timezones and location mappings see IANA Database and Geonames Database.

x_loc_city.description: The generic name of the client city.

x_loc_state.description: A code which could be up to three characters, that represent the client's state/region. The region is the first-level subdivision (the broadest or least specific) of the ISO 3166-2 code.

x_loc_state_name.description: The name of the client's state/region. The region is the first-level subdivision (the broadest or least specific) of the ISO 3166-2 code.

x_loc_country.description: The two letter country code for the client's country. For a list of country codes, see ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. One of: AD, AE, AF, AG, AI, AL, AM, AO, AQ, AR, AS, AT, AU, AW, AX, AZ, BA, BB, BD, BE, BF, BG, BH, BI, BJ, BL, BM, BN, BO, BQ, BR, BS, BT, BV, BW, BY, BZ, CA, CC, CD, CF, CG, CH, CI, CK, CL, CM, CN, CO, CR, CU, CV, CW, CX, CY, CZ, DE, DJ, DK, DM, DO, DZ, EC, EE, EG, EH, ER, ES, ET, FI, FJ, FK, FM, FO, FR, GA.

api_version.description: The API version to use. This is denoted by the format `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default is the latest that is available. Read more about API versioning.

cache_control.description: Brave Search will return cached content by default. To prevent caching set the Cache-Control header to `no-cache`. This is currently done as best effort.

query.description: Search query string and its modifications that are used for search. Fields: original, show_strict_warning, altered, cleaned, safesearch, is_navigational, is_geolocal, local_decision, local_locations_idx, is_trending, is_news_breaking, ask_for_location, language, spellcheck_off, ....

discussions.description: Discussions clusters aggregated from forum posts that are relevant to the query. Fields: type, results, mutated_by_goggles.

faq.description: Frequently asked questions that are relevant to the search query. Fields: type, results.

infobox.description: Aggregated information on an entity showable as an infobox. Fields: type, results.

locations.description: Places of interest (POIs) relevant to location sensitive queries. Fields: type, results, provider.

mixed.description: Preferred ranked order of search results. Fields: type, main, top, side.

news.description: News results relevant to the query. Fields: type, results, mutated_by_goggles.

videos.description: Videos results relevant to the query. Fields: type, results, mutated_by_goggles.

web.description: Web results relevant to the query. Fields: type, results, family_friendly.

summarizer.description: Summary key to get summary results for the query. Fields: type, key.

rich.description: Callback information to retrieve rich results. Fields: type, hint.

place_search.title: Place search
place_search.description: Place search. Search for points of interest in an area. If no `q` is provided, the endpoint will return general points of interest in the given area.

radius.description: Search radius bias around the given coordinates, in meters. NOTE : This is not strictly the radius of the search (nor the resulting radius of the results), but rather a bias towards results that are closer to the given coordinates. Search is performed globally if no radius is provided.

q.description: The user's search query term. Query can not be empty. Maximum of 600 characters and 75 words in the query.

country.description: The search query country, where the results come from. The country string is limited to 2 character country codes of supported countries. When not set, no filtering is applied — except for local recall, which stays `strict`.

spellcheck.description: Whether to enable spellcheck on the query. Default: true.

maximum_number_of_urls.description: Maximum number of different URLs to include in LLM context. Default: 20.

maximum_number_of_tokens.description: Approximate maximum number of tokens to include in context. The default is `8192` and maximum is `32768`.

maximum_number_of_snippets.description: Maximum number of different snippets (or chunks of text) to include in LLM context. The default is `50` and maximum is `256`.

context_threshold_mode.description: The mode to use to determine the threshold for including content in context.

maximum_number_of_tokens_per_url.description: Maximum number of tokens to include per URL. The default is `4096` and maximum is `8192`.

maximum_number_of_snippets_per_url.description: Maximum number of snippets to include per URL. The default is `50` and maximum is `100`.

freshness.description: Filters search results by page age. The age of a page is determined by the most relevant date reported by the content, such as its published or last modified date. The following values are supported: - pd - Pages aged 24 hours or less. - pw - Pages aged 7 days or less. - pm - Pages aged 31 days or less. - py - Pages aged 365 days or less.

enable_local.description: Whether to enable local recall. Not setting this value means auto-detect: local recall is used if a location is provided (`X-Loc-Lat` with `X-Loc-Long`, or `X-Loc-City`).

enable_source_metadata.description: Enable source metadata enrichment (site_name, favicon, thumbnail, description, fetched_content_timestamp) in the sources attribute of the response. Default: false.

x_loc_lat.description: The latitude of the client's geographical location in degrees, to provide relevant local results. The latitude must be greater than or equal to -90.0 degrees and less than or equal to +90.0 degrees. Range -90 to 90.

x_loc_long.description: The longitude of the client's geographical location in degrees, to provide relevant local results. The longitude must be greater than or equal to -180.0 and less than or equal to +180.0 degrees. Range -180 to 180.

x_loc_city.description: The generic name of the client city

x_loc_state.description: A code which could be up to three characters, that represent the client's state/region. The region is the first-level subdivision (the broadest or least specific) of the ISO 3166-2 code.

x_loc_state_name.description: The name of the client's state/region. The region is the first-level subdivision (the broadest or least specific) of the ISO 3166-2 code.

x_loc_country.description: The two letter country code for the client's country. create_answer.title: Create an answer
create_answer.description: Ask Brave's Answers API a question and get an AI-generated answer grounded in live web search, in the OpenAI chat-completions shape. Exactly one user message is supported. The API streams by default and citations, entities and research mode all require streaming; this tool reads a single JSON body, so pass stream=false for a plain answer.

messages.description: The conversation so far. Exactly one `user` message is supported, e.g. `[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain quantum computing"}]`. Each item has: role, content.

model.description: Model ID used to generate the response. Default: brave-pro.

metadata.description: Accepted for OpenAI SDK compatibility and currently ignored: the pairs are not stored or returned.

seed.description: Accepted for OpenAI SDK compatibility and currently ignored: answers are not reproducible.

stream.description: Whether to stream the answer as server-sent events; the API's own default is true. Pass false to get one JSON response from this tool; enable_citations, enable_entities and enable_research need true.

enable_entities.description: Whether to include inline entity tags in the answer. Requires `stream=true` and is not supported in research mode. Default: false.

enable_citations.description: Whether to include inline citation tags in the answer. Requires `stream=true` and is not supported in research mode. Default: false.

enable_research.description: Whether to answer with iterative deep research instead of a single search. Requires `stream=true`. Default: false.

research_allow_thinking.description: Accepted for compatibility. Ignored by the mixer engine behind this API, which always runs research with extended thinking off. Default: true.

research_maximum_number_of_tokens_per_qu.description: Maximum number of tokens to gather per research query. Default: 8192.

research_maximum_number_of_queries.description: Maximum number of search queries research mode may issue in total. Default: 20.

research_maximum_number_of_iterations.description: Maximum number of research iterations. Default: 4.

research_maximum_number_of_seconds.description: Time budget for research, in seconds. Default: 180.

research_maximum_number_of_results_per_q.description: Maximum number of search results to consider per research query. Default: 30.

suggest.title: Suggest queries
suggest.description: Autocomplete a partial query: returns the completions Brave Search would offer as the user types, tailored to country and language. With rich=true each suggestion also carries entity metadata (title, description, image) where Brave recognises one. Needs a plan that includes Autosuggest.

q.description: The query to work on. Maximum 400 characters and 50 words.

country.description: 2-letter country code the suggestions or corrections are tailored to, e.g. US, DE, JP. Default: US.

lang.description: 2 or more character language code the query is written in, e.g. en, fr, de. Default: en.

count.description: How many suggestions to return (1-20). Fewer may come back. Default: 5.

rich.description: True to enrich suggestions with entity metadata. Requires a paid Autosuggest plan. Default: false.

results.description: Suggestions, each with query and, when rich, is_entity, title, description and img.

spellcheck.title: Spellcheck a query
spellcheck.description: Check a query's spelling the way Brave Search does before it searches. Returns the corrected query when one is found, and an empty result list when the query is already spelled correctly. Needs a plan that includes Spellcheck.

q.description: The query to work on. Maximum 400 characters and 50 words.

country.description: 2-letter country code the suggestions or corrections are tailored to, e.g. US, DE, JP. Default: US.

lang.description: 2 or more character language code the query is written in, e.g. en, fr, de. Default: en.

results.description: Corrections, each {query}; empty when nothing needed fixing.
